enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Scratch nose. Yawn. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Exit bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Say 'Good morning' to receptionist. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs at nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Pick up phone. Dial number. Talk on phone. Write notes. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Sit in meeting. Take notes. Speak in meeting. Walk back to desk. Open program database. Update records. Call community center. Type proposal.

Walk out of office. Say 'Good night' to colleagues. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Stand up from table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Carry plates to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plates. Place plates in dishwasher. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Close dishwasher. Pick up pots. Scrub pots with sponge. Rinse pots. Place pots in drying rack. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off tap. Sweep floor. Empty dustpan into trash.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to couch. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Leave living room.

Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Press power button. Log in. Open browser. Check social media. Open email. Read emails. Reply to email. Open document. Type document. Save document. Close browser. Open music player. Play music. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to back. Stretch. Yawn. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
